title: Servizio di tesoreria comunale
description: Servizio di tesoreria comunale. L’affidamento del servizio di tesoreria oggetto del presente appalto, come previsto dall’art. 209 del D.lgs. n. 267/2000 e ss.mm.ii., è costituito dal “complesso delle operazioni legate alla gestione finanziaria dell’ente locale e finalizzate in particolare alla riscossione delle entrate, al pagamento delle spese, alla custodia di titoli e valori ed agli adempimenti connessi previsti dalla legge, dallo statuto, dai regolamenti dell’ente o da norme pattizie”. Il contratto e gli obblighi delle parti sono analiticamente descritti nella convenzione approvata con delibera di Consiglio Comunale n. 5 del 28.01.2026 e nel capitolato speciale. L’appalto è a corpo ed è costituito da un unico lotto in quanto, per le caratteristiche del servizio e le particolari modalità esecutive delle prestazioni, si rende necessaria una gestione unitaria ed omogenea da parte di un solo operatore economico, al fine di assicurare l’efficace coordinamento delle attività oggetto dell’appalto e l’ottimizzazione delle risorse. L’importo dell’appalto a base di gara per l’arco di durata quinquennale ammonta ad € 1.600.000,00 (euro unmilioneseicentomila/00), esente IVA. L’Ente ha provveduto a chiudere i dossier titoli in custodia presso la tesoreria comunale; pertanto, al ''corrispettivo omnicomprensivo del servizio di tesoreria e cassa'' si ritiene applicabile l'esenzione di cui all'articolo 10, primo comma, n. 1) del d.P.R. n. 633 del 1972 (giusta parere Agenzia delle Entrate Risposta n. 188/2023). L’importo a base di gara comprende i costi della manodopera che la stazione appaltante ha stimato pari ad € 203.580,00. In considerazione della natura del servizio oggetto della presente gara, non sussiste la necessità di procedere alla predisposizione del DUVRI ex D.lgs. 81/2008, tenuto conto altresì che il servizio si svolge presso le sedi del Tesoriere. La durata dell’appalto (escluse le eventuali opzioni) è di 5 anni naturali e consecutivi decorrenti dalla data di sottoscrizione della convenzione o dall’avvio del servizio o dalla data di esecuzione anticipata del servizio.

title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Verkauf Campusnetz
description: WISTA steht für Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof und ist ein hochmoderner Technologiepark im Berliner Ortsteil Adlershof (Bezirk Treptow-Köpenick). Er gilt als einer der fortschrittlichsten Hochtechnologieparks Europas und ist ein zentraler Ort für Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Gründungen. WISTA Adlershof als Standort mit ca. 4,2 km² Fläche, ca. 1.300 Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Hochschulinstituten mit 28.000 Mitarbeitenden, Die WISTA Management GmbH agiert als Standortentwickler, Dienstleister und Wirtschaftsförderer. Sie unterstützt Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Start-ups am Standort und fördert Innovation und Wachstum in der Region. Neben ihrem Immobilienbestand verfügt WISTA über ein eigenes Campusnetz, das aus einem leistungsfähigen Kabelnetz sowie einer 5G-Infrastruktur besteht. Das Netz wurde seit 1998 kontinuierlich ausgebaut und technologisch weiterentwickelt – von klassischen Telefonie- und Datendiensten über Gigabit- und 10G-Anbindungen, Cloud- und UCC-Integration, campusweites WLAN und IoT-Anwendungen bis hin zu lokalem 5G und aktuellen Netzwerk-4.0-Themen. Es bildet damit eine wesentliche digitale Infrastruktur des Campus und ist Gegenstand des Interessenbekundungsverfahrens. Die Attraktivität des Campusnetzes ergibt sich aus seiner etablierten Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur an einem dynamisch wachsenden Hochtechnologiestandort. Das Netz verfügt über eine bestehende Kundenbasis, gewachsene Leitungswege und Netzknoten sowie redundante Carrier-Anbindungen. Zusätzliche Entwicklungsperspektiven ergeben sich aus der fortlaufenden Erweiterung des Campus durch neue Gebäude, dem Ausbaupotenzial für Cloud-, Security- und UCC-Dienste sowie der Ergänzung durch ein lokales 5G-Campusnetz. Damit bietet das Campusnetz eine belastbare infrastrukturelle Grundlage mit weiterem wirtschaftlichem und technologischem Wachstumspotenzial. Die Beweggründe für den Verkauf durch die WISTA sind eine strategische Weiterentwicklung des Campusnetzes durch einen spezialisierten Provider, mit qualifiziertem Personal und dem notwendigen Knowhow. Verkaufsgegenstand: Passive Infrastruktur (LWL, Kupfer, Rohre, Schächte, Kabelverzweiger, Hausanschlüsse) Aktive Infrastruktur (Switche, Router, Server, TK-System) Kundenverträge (soweit übertragbar, Zustimmung/ Überleitungen müssen noch geprüft werden) Frequenzzuteilung 5G (nicht veräußerbar, Nachnutzung/ Übertragung noch regulatorisch zu prüfen, Beantragung eigener Zuteilung erforderlich) Grundstücks-/Leitungsrechte (soweit übertragbar, Dienstbarkeiten/Gestattungen noch zu prüfen) Software/Lizenzen (soweit übertragbar, Lizenzbedingungen noch zu prüfen) Kabelnetz: Das WISTA-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof bildet die zentrale Kommunikationsinfrastruktur für Sprach- und Datendienste im Kerngebiet des Technologieparks. Es versorgt derzeit rund 400 Kunden sowie ca. 4.400 Teilnehmer im Voice-Bereich und ist damit ein wesentlicher Standortfaktor für Deutschlands größten Wissenschafts- und Technologiepark. Die vorhandene Infrastruktur umfasst eine leistungsfähige Kabelkanalanlage, ein Leitungsnetz auf Kupfer- und Glasfaserbasis, mit einer Gesamtlänge von knapp 20 Kilometern, sowie ein Gigabit-Ethernet-Backbone. Technisch genutzt werden insbesondere LWL-Backbone-Verbindungen, Monomode- und Multimode-Glasfaserkabel, Kupferkabel, Kupfer-Querkabel sowie FM-Kabel mit 100 Doppeladern. Auf der aktiven Netz- und Dienste Ebene umfasst das Campusnetz Übertragungs- und Vermittlungseinrichtungen für Sprach- und Datenkommunikation, Routing-/Switching-Komponenten, Datencore- und Accessbereiche, Netzübergänge in Weitverkehrsnetze sowie einen Kommunikationsverbund aus Kommunikationssystemen des Herstellers Unify. Die vorhandene Sprach- und Dateninfrastruktur der Nutzer ist an das Netz angeschlossen; ein Teil der Nutzer ist über LAN-Anschlüsse unter 100 Mbit/s bzw. VDSL angebunden, weitere Nutzer verfügen über Anschlüsse ab 100 Mbit/s. Die WAN-Anbindung ist redundant mit mindestens zwei externen Carriern ausgelegt und verfügt über zwei redundante Übergänge mit 100 Gbit/s. Das Campusnetz ist insbesondere als etablierte, betreiberfähige Infrastruktur mit bestehender Kundenbasis, vorhandenen Leitungswegen, dokumentierten Netzübergängen und Entwicklungspotenzial interessant. Der künftige Betreiber soll das Netz eigenverantwortlich betreiben, instand halten, fortentwickeln und gegenüber den Nutzern aktiv vermarkten. Wertrelevant sind neben der bestehenden Kupfer-, LWL- und Glasfaserinfrastruktur insbesondere die Bestandskunden, die vorhandenen TK- und Datennetzkomponenten, die Ausbaupotenziale am wachsenden Standort Adlershof sowie die Möglichkeit zur Einführung neuer Cloud-, Security-, VoIP- und UCC-Dienste. 5G-Netz: Das WISTA 5G-Campusnetz ist als lokales privates 5G-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof konzipiert. Es dient als Ergänzung der bestehenden Kabelinfrastruktur und soll sukzessive an Outdoor- und Indoor-Standorten ausgebaut werden. Ein initialer Ausbau ist im Bereich Albert-Einstein-Straße 16 (zentraler Outdoor-Standort) sowie im Showroom/a:head-Kontext (Indoor-Standort) vorgenommen worden. Regulatorische Grundlage der 5G-Infrastruktur ist eine lokale Frequenzzuteilung der Bundesnetzagentur für den Frequenzbereich 3.700–3.800 MHz. Zuteilungsinhaberin ist die WISTA Management GmbH. Die zugeteilte Bandbreite beträgt 100 MHz; die Frequenzzuteilung ist bis zum 20.02.2030 befristet. Das Zuteilungsgebiet umfasst eine Fläche von ca. 0,873273 km². Technologisch basiert die 5G-Infrastruktur auf einer Nokia DAC/NDAC Medium+ Umgebung mit 5G Standalone-Architektur, Edge Core, NDAC-Manager, Nokia AirScale-Komponenten, HPE Edge Servern, Router- und Switching-Komponenten sowie SIM-Kit.

title: 11797 Protection contre les crues et revitalisation du Rot / Soppistigbach, Buttisholz
description:
Résumé:

La présente offre porte sur des prestations d'ingénierie conformément à la norme SIA 103, phases 31 à 33, dans le domaine de l'ingénierie hydraulique, à savoir la protection contre les crues et la revitalisation de la Rot et du Soppistigbach dans la commune de Buttisholz, canton de Lucerne.


Contexte:

En 2016, l’élaboration d’un projet de protection contre les crues a été lancée, visant à remplacer le pont routier cantonal existant qui enjambe la Rot. Au cours de l’élaboration du projet, l’intérêt d’élargir le périmètre du projet a été reconnu et d’autres objectifs ont été définis, notamment la mise en œuvre de mesures de protection contre les crues et la valorisation écologique de la Rot et du Soppistigbach. Entre-temps, un avant-projet a été élaboré, mais celui-ci présente un rapport coûts-avantages défavorable et nécessite encore plusieurs ajustements.


Mission:

Sur la base des données disponibles, il convient tout d'abord de réaliser une nouvelle étude des variantes au cours de la phase d'avant-projet. Une fois l'avant-projet achevé, il conviendra d'élaborer le projet de construction et le projet soumis à l'approbation des autorités. Le projet global est ici divisé en deux sous-projets : l'un consacré aux ouvrages hydrauliques et l'autre à la construction des ponts. La présente procédure d'appel d'offres ne porte que sur les travaux de conception du sous-projet « ouvrages hydrauliques ». Dès que les conditions-cadres pour la construction des ponts pourront être définies, le sous-projet « construction des ponts » fera l'objet d'une procédure d'appel d'offres distincte.

title: APN - Housing Construction Plan
description: Advance Procurement Notice Housing Construction plan Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. This is an advance notice for potential contracts to provide interested Design-Builders an opportunity to learn about the upcoming housing construction program. Note that there is no guarantee that these solicitations will proceed. Description of the Program and Services The Canadian Forces Housing Agency (CFHA) is planning a Housing Program to support the delivery of new residential housing for members of the Canadian Armed Forces at bases and wings across Canada. CFHA is responsible for the provision and management of military housing on Department of National Defence (DND) lands, and this program supports ongoing efforts to modernize and expand the housing portfolio to meet current and future operational needs. The objective of the program is to deliver new housing efficiently and at speed through Modified Design -Build (MDB) delivery model that integrates studies, design and construction under a single contract. The services required under this program include: Architectural & Engineering (A&E) services for the provision site studies, planning and detailed design development and all associated works. Design and construction of new infrastructure and housing to support the residential housing program. Note that certain locations may involve phased delivery. Planned building types will emphasize higher-density development, primarily mid-rise apartment buildings. The proposed number of units at each location is subject to adjustment as requirements are finalized. It is anticipated that each location will be delivered under its own Modified Design-Build (MDB) contract. However, subject to change, certain locations may be bundled and procured through a single Request for Proposals (RFP), as outlined below in no particular order. title: USACE National Enterprise Dredging Center Scope Dredge to Budget Contract
description: Special Notice: W912PM27RA006 Title: Virtual Industry Day for FY27 USACE Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center Scope Dredge to Budget The Virtual Industry Day Meeting for the USACE Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center Scope Dredge to Budget will occur on 16 October 2026 from 0900ET to 13:00ET via Teams. All interested dredging companies are encouraged to attend. During the meeting, we will be discussing Scope Dredge to Budget acquisition strategy. Scope Dredge to Budget: Optimize the Budget in terms of quality, scope, durability with innovative betterments and betterments within the budget. The goal of the scope-dredge to budget is maximizing achievable scope within a target budget that will be provided in the solicitation. The Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center intends to issue 1 solicitation for the Galveston/Houston Area of Responsibility. Phase One -A technical qualifications-based evaluation of initial proposals -RFP that defines the project with functional and performance requirements, budget cap, and schedule/delivery requirements -A statement of the maximum number of offerors that will be selected to submit Phase 2 proposals. -RFO FAR 36.101-2(b)(4) states maximum number of offerors shall not exceed five (5) Phase One proposals from vendors do not include: -Detailed design information -Cost or price information Down-select Decision for most highly qualified offerors in accordance with the solicitation. Proposed Phase 1 Qualifications -Proof of bonding capacity -Past Performance -Proposed Plant Proprietary Meetings (RFO FAR 15.101 Exchanges with Industry before receipt of proposals) Phase Two in accordance with FAR 15 Source Selection Procedures to determine best value. Official Phase Two RFP issued by amendment for most highly qualified offerors to submit phase-two competitive proposals that include technical proposals and cost or price information. Proposed Phase 2 Evaluation Factors -Maximum amount of time to maintain the channels at authorized dimensions -Maximum use of beneficial use -Schedule -Management Approach The harbors to be dredged include the Sabine-Neches Waterway, Galveston Harbor & Channel, Houston Ship Channel, Texas City Ship Channel, Freeport Harbor, Matagorda Ship Channel, Corpus Christi Ship Channel, Brazos Island Harbor, Gulf Intracoastal Waterway & Tributaries, Channel to Victoria, and Channel to Harlington. See Attachment 1 for project descriptions and map. Please RSVP no later than 10AM ET 15 October 2026 to both Ros Shoemaker and Terri Adams at Rosalind.m.shoemaker@usace.army.mil and terri.m.adams@usace.army.mil if you plan to attend the Industry Day. A Teams calendar invite will be sent out to all RSVP�s. Industry is also encouraged to provide any feedback on the proposed acquisition strategies or contract pairings. Feedback can be provided via email to the contracting officer and contract specialist listed above. If you would like to provide any questions in advance of the meeting, please provide them no later than 10AM ET, 08 September 2026.

title: NISC Enterprise Support Tasking (NEST)
description: ***THIS OPPORTUNITY IS SET-ASIDE FOR WOMEN-OWNED SMALL BUSINESS (WOSB) CONCERNS*** **A LIVE NIMS DEMONSTRATION WILL OCCUR 09 SEP 2026, SEE L.8 FOR DETAILS** The AJW-2 Directorate, AJW-2131 Implementation Services Group, provides technical, engineering, financial, budget, and management support to Technical Operations programs using the NAS Integration Support Contract (NISC IV Contract) and Technical Support Services Contract (TSSC).These are task order contracts that present contract managers with the task of managing the entire Task Order Management lifecycle, the Financial Management lifecycle encompassing the obligation and de-obligation of funds by integrating with FAA�s financial systems, PRISM and Delphi and the Invoice/Payments lifecycle. The NISC IV contract will also be transitioned to NISC V contract during the award period, which will require a new system to support the NISC V contract, while maintaining the NIMS system to close out the NISC IV contract. This work requires a support contractor that will provide Operations and Maintenance services for the NIMS systems that is used to manage the current NISC IV contract using the existing technology stack and will provide quality assurance and quality control to ensure uninterrupted system availability. In addition, the vendor should maintain and run reports if required from CMIS system that was used to support the NISC III contract and is currently not active. The work also requires the vendor to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) capable of providing design, development, testing, deployment and documentation of the new software that will be required to support the NISC V contract when required. This includes, but is not limited to, making recommendations regarding the selection of software architecture and software development tools that will be required to develop the new system. The Contractor must provide operations and maintenance support for the NIMS/CMIS system, provide quality assurance and quality control, provide security compliance and ensure uninterrupted system availability. description: ***THIS OPPORTUNITY IS SET-ASIDE FOR WOMEN-OWNED SMALL BUSINESS (WOSB) CONCERNS*** **A LIVE NIMS DEMONSTRATION WILL OCCUR 09 SEP 2026, SEE L.8 FOR DETAILS** The AJW-2 Directorate, AJW-2131 Implementation Services Group, provides technical, engineering, financial, budget, and management support to Technical Operations programs using the NAS Integration Support Contract (NISC IV Contract) and Technical Support Services Contract (TSSC).These are task order contracts that present contract managers with the task of managing the entire Task Order Management lifecycle, the Financial Management lifecycle encompassing the obligation and de-obligation of funds by integrating with FAA�s financial systems, PRISM and Delphi and the Invoice/Payments lifecycle. The NISC IV contract will also be transitioned to NISC V contract during the award period, which will require a new system to support the NISC V contract, while maintaining the NIMS system to close out the NISC IV contract. This work requires a support contractor that will provide Operations and Maintenance services for the NIMS systems that is used to manage the current NISC IV contract using the existing technology stack and will provide quality assurance and quality control to ensure uninterrupted system availability. In addition, the vendor should maintain and run reports if required from CMIS system that was used to support the NISC III contract and is currently not active. The work also requires the vendor to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) capable of providing design, development, testing, deployment and documentation of the new software that will be required to support the NISC V contract when required. This includes, but is not limited to, making recommendations regarding the selection of software architecture and software development tools that will be required to develop the new system. The Contractor must provide operations and maintenance support for the NIMS/CMIS system, provide quality assurance and quality control, provide security compliance and ensure uninterrupted system availability. This effort also requires the vendor to serve as a SME and provide support with system architecture, software recommendations, system design, development, testing, deployment, and documentation for a new system to support NISC V contract requirements when required. Contractor will maintain NIMS/CMIS security certifications required to operate the software and its associated server hardware. The Contractor must also provide transition support to any potential new vendor at the contract�s end. ***THIS OPPORTUNITY IS SET-ASIDE FOR WOMEN-OWNED SMALL BUSINESS (WOSB) CONCERNS*** **A LIVE NIMS DEMONSTRATION WILL OCCUR 09 SEP 2026, SEE L.8 FOR DETAILS**

title: Sepsis Research Blood Sample Collection Services
description: Notice of Intent (NOI) to Sole Source Title: Sepsis Research Blood Sample Collection Services Requiring Activity: Walter Reed Army Institute of Research (WRAIR), Integrative Systems Biology (ISB) Branch Related Notice: HT942523P0084 Product Service Code (PSC): AN11 - HEALTH R&D SERVICES; HEALTH CARE SERVICES; BASIC RESEARCH North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code: 541714 - Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) Small Business Size Standard: 1000 employees The Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity (DHACA) on behalf of the Integrative Systems Biology (ISB) Branch at the Walter Reed Army Institute of Research (WRAIR) intends to extend current contract services as a cost R&D contract on a sole source basis to Medstar Health Research Institute, Inc. (MHRI), 10980 Grantchester Way 7th Fl, Columbia, MD 21044-6097 USA; Cage Code 3J1M2 under the RFO FAR 6.103-1 � Only one responsible source can supply the required products due to the non-commercially available sources of the blood samples the Government is requesting. Description of Requirement: This is a requirement to extend and re-structure a Firm-Fixed Price contract into a Research and Development (R&D) cost type contract vehicle that will allow the Integrative Systems Biology (ISB) Branch to procure samples from septic and non-septic burn patients along with longitudinal clinical data for the assessment of biomarkers of sepsis for refinement and validation of SeptiBurnAlert program. These blood samples; to include longitudinal clinical data, are currently being collected by MHRI in accordance with an approved Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocol and are actively recruiting subjects for patient samples that meet the specific thermally injured criteria. The Government will convert the current contract from a firm fixed price award to a cost type, RFO part 35 R&D contract to better align the requirement with the Government�s needs. This special notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals, and no solicitation document exists for this requirement. Meaningful submissions received in response to this notice will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether competitive procurement is in the best interest of the Government. If no meaningful, written submissions are received by the date listed below, after the publication of this notice, the solicitation will be issued as a sole source requirement to Medstar Health Research Institute, Inc. Based on the above information, the only technically acceptable vendor to fulfill this requirement is MHRI. Submit capability statements (using PDF, MS Word, or Excel attachments) to Ms. Nicole Applegate at e-mail: nicole.v.applegate.civ@health.mil Capability statements are due no later than 10:00am Eastern Time on October 15, 2026.

title: Industry Day U.S. Merchant Marine Academy Campus Modernization
description: FALL FY27 INDUSTRY DAY U.S. Merchant Marine Academy Campus Modernization Industry Day Special Notice | Thursday, October 15, 2026 Event Overview The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), New York District, and the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy (USMMA) will host the Fall FY27 Industry Day from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 15, 2026. The hybrid event will bring industry, government, community organizations, and other interested attendees together with USMMA and USACE leadership for an updated view of the Campus Modernization Initiative, its strategic direction, and anticipated procurement activity. This event is open to the general public, and interested vendors. The FY27-FY28 forecast will emphasize the substantial heavy construction opportunities central to the modernization program while also addressing utility upgrades and complementary supporting and non-construction requirements. In-person participation is strongly encouraged. Prior registration is required for every attendee and closes at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 12, 2026. Event Information Event: USMMA Campus Modernization Fall FY27 Industry Day Date: Thursday, October 15, 2026 Event Time: 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time Check-In: Opens at 10:00 a.m.; in-person attendees should arrive no later than 10:45 a.m. to allow at least 15 minutes for networking before the program begins Location: U.S. Merchant Marine Academy, 300 Steamboat Road, Kings Point, NY 11024; enter through the main gate Format: Hybrid; in-person attendance is strongly encouraged. Registered virtual attendees will receive a Microsoft Teams link on October 13, 2026 Audience: All interested attendees age 16 or older (public attendees welcome) Registration Deadline: 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday, October 12, 2026 Theme: USACE Partnering with Industry and the Local Community Industry Day Highlights The Industry Day program will include the following: Welcome and Keynote Remarks: USACE leadership, USMMA Academy leadership, and invited guests will discuss the modernization program, acquisition approaches, and community impacts. Strategic Program Overview: A general USMMA overview and FY27-FY28 Campus Modernization update, including the strategic vision, updated waterfall chart, and local-government and community considerations. Heavy Construction Forecast: A focused review of the significant heavy construction opportunities expected to drive the modernization program. Specific project names, dollar ranges, and acquisition methods will be presented at the event rather than released in this notice. Supporting and Utility Requirements: Discussion of utility upgrades and complementary non-construction requirements that support successful delivery of the broader construction program. title: RESERVE BASIN MAINTENANCE DREDGING CONTRACT FOR SITES AT THE PHILDELPHIA NAVY YARD IN THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT PENNSYLVANIA AREA OF RESPONSIBILIY
description: The project consists of Maintenance Dredging within the North Side (Wharf N) of Reserve Basin and Schuylkill River Access Channel for the Government sites at the Philadelphia Navy Yard in the Public Works Department Pennsylvania area of responsibility. Maintenance dredging of approximately 96,611 cubic yards of sediment, using a sealed environmental clamshell bucket. Dredging within the Reserve Basin is in support of the Naval Support Activity Mechanicsburg, Philadelphia Navy Yard Annex. The Reserve Basin is being used to decommission various US Naval vessels. For the river pilots to be able to safely maneuver vessels through the Schuylkill River into the Reserve Basin berths and to ensure that tidal cycles will not cause sediment accumulation around the hulls making final removal very difficult, the berths need to be dredged to a minimum depth of -30 MLLW and a maximum over-dredge depth of -32 MLLW.

REQUIREMENTS The contractor shall maintain a quality control system which meets the requirements of Mil-I-45208A, Mil-Q 9858,ISO-9000 / 9001 / 9002 or equivalent. RESPONSIBILITY FOR INSPECTION: Unless otherwise specified, the contractor is responsible for the performance of all inspection requirements as specified herein. Except as otherwise specified, the contractor may use his own or any other facility suitable for the performance of the inspection requirements specified herein. PROCEDURES:The contractor shall prepare and maintain Quality Control Documentation, test and repair procedures, and inspection procedures which shall be made available to the Government for review and approval. The procedures shall include sequential diagrams of the test, repair, and inspection process, as well as the performance spcifications to perform the procedures. QUALITY ASSURANCE PROGRAM PLAN: The contractor shall develop, implement and maintain a Repair Quality Plan in compliance with the requirements of Mil-I-45208A, Mil-Q-9858, ISO,9000 / 9001 / 9002, or equvalent.The plan shall define the specific methods by which compliance with contractual requirements will be assured. All quality assurance data shall be provided to the Government for review and approval upon request. PURCHASED MATERIAL CONTROL: The contractor shall establish and maintain a system of control over purchased material which shall assure that the necessary requirements of this contract are included. in all sub contract agreements. A parts control system shall establish a record of performance for each purchased and internally manufactured part and shall be used to evaluate continued use of the source. The contractors control system shall be in compliance wil either Mil-I 45208A/Mil-Q-9858 or equivalent Quality Quality Assurance Standared.(ISO/AS:9000, 9001, 9002). RECEIVING INSPECTION OF PURCHASED MATERIAL: Purchased items shall be inspected upon receipt at the contractors facility to assure conformance with all requirements of the Technical Data Package (TDP). Evidence of such inspections shall be maintained for Government review at least twelve (12) months following acceptance of the end item. Inspection reports shall be maintained by the contractor. The inspection report shall, at a minimum, include a record of all dimensional data (coordinate/positional), material, finish, and process with appropriate pass/fail criteria, such ascertifications, and actual dimensional readings. FAILURE ANALYSIS AND CORRECTIVE ACTION:All failure analysis and corrective action reports/plans shall be submitted to the Government. NONCONFORMING MATERIAL:The contractor shall establish an effective system for controlling nonconforming material including procedures for identification, segregation, and disposition. CONTRACTOR INTERNAL REVIEW BOARD (IRB):IRB authority is delegated to the contractor for this contract only. The IRB may be used only for disposition of materials exhibiting minor non-conformances, scrap or rework to return a part to conformance with drawings or specifications as authorized by the approved repair procedures.IRB shall not use "AS-IS" disposition. A complete file of IRB actions shall be maintained for review by the Government for concurrance of classification. MATERIAL REVIEW BOARD (MRB):Formal MRB authority for disposition of "AS-IS"and for minor non-conformances is retained by the Government. The contractor shall submit the appropriate request for Variance via the DCMC to the NAVSUP Contracting Officer. RESPONSIBILITY FOR COMPLIANCE: All items must meet all requirements of this Statement of Work. The inspection requirements set forth in this SOW shall become part of the contractors overall inspection system or quality program. The absence of any inspection requirements in the SOW shall not relieve the contractor of the responsibility of assuring that all Government equipment submitted for acceptance comply with all requirements. Sampling in quality conformance does not authorize submission of known defective items, either indicated or actual, nor does it commit the procuring activity to acceptance of any defective items. REPAIR ASSESSMENT TESTING: The Government may select samples of the Contract Line Items (CLINS) which have completed repair and have been accepted by the Government representative for the purpose of conducting performance testing, environmental testing, and quality conformance examination in a repair assessment test program. A quantity of CLIN's may be randomly selected from each quaterly repair production completion for shipment to the CFA or other Government designated location to conduct this testing. RECORDS OF DATA COLLECTION: The contractor shall maintain a historical record file to contain copies of applicable data and documents for individual CLIN's and assemblies by CLIN serial number. title: KC-135 Center Console Refresh (CCR) Revision 2
description: 12 August Amendment 02 to revise documents as a result of Q&A. 28 Jul 26 Amendment 01 to revised documents as a result of Q&A. 10 Jul 26 Center Console Refresh addresses critical obsolescence issues within the KC-135 Refueling Tanker aircraft. The US Air Force needs an updated Fuel System (FS), Flight Display System (FDS), and Flight Computer due to obsolescence and is looking for innovative ideas to not only replace but improve these systems with turn-key solutions enabling supportability and future growth. The FS, FDS, Flight Computer, and the future growth/adaptability define the scope of the CCR program. The program scope also includes the addition of autothrottle systems. The anticipated contract will be a Cost-Plus Incentive Fee (CPIF) for EMD, Firm Fixed Price (FFP) for Production and Deployment (P&D), single award indefinite delivery/quantity type contract comprised of One (1) 48-month Base Period with Six (6) 1-Year Option Periods and a projected period of performance from July 2028 to June 2038. title: Protective Coatings Requirements Contract
description: The 319th Contracting Squadron at Grand Forks Air Force Base, ND is issuing this Request for Proposal (RFP) to award a Firm-Fixed-Price Requirements Contract for protective coating and painting services across base industrial facilities. The Contractor shall perform both exterior and interior painting, including painting walls, ceilings, concrete floors, exterior building surfaces, pavements, parking lot striping, airfield striping, parking ramp markings (arrows), and fire hydrants; installing and repairing wall coverings; and taping, bedding, and texturing walls, as required by applicable federal, state, Air Force, UFC, and OEM standards. Proposals are due by 15 October 2026 at 4:30 PM CST and shall be submitted electronically to SSgt Jackelyn Richardson at jackelyn.richardson.1@us.af.mil or Mrs. Carly J. title: Blanket Purchase Agreement of Laboratory Analyses Services for Worldwide Support
description: AMENDMENT 0002: this combined synopsis / solicitation has been amended, and the Small Business set-aside category has been broadened in order to promote more robust competition for these requirements, where the Government still intends to award multiple agreements for the requirement (as denoted in the attachment). Additionally, the ELIN attachment (Lab Services) have been updated, with a reduction in line items, as well to improve competition. As a result, any offeror that has previously submitted quotes for consideration will have to provide a new ELIN quote submittal, but are still elible for award consideration. At this time, the original proposal due date has been extended to April 30, 2026; were the Contracting Officer to issue any further amendments to the proposal information, they will be posted to this same public record for widest and most-timely distribution. AMENDMENT 0001: responses to RFI have been posted to close the RFI event, and historical data for informational purposes has been posted as well. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice (attachments). This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. The requiring activity has determined that establishment of Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPA) is both appropriate and would be advantageous, and as a result quotes are being sought for the establishment of long-term agreements as a result. Interested vendors shall prepare to furnish laboratory analyses services and associated laboratory supplies, if and when requested by the Contracting Officer (or the authorized Representative of the Contracting Officer) anticipated as (but limited to) five one-year periods starting in 2026. Attached to this advertisement are pre-award evaluation procedures, proposal requirements for responsiveness and responsibility determinations, and a full set of objectives and standards for future ordering and performance. The solicitation utilizes source selection procedures which require offerors to submit a technical proposal, past performance and experience information, and pricing quotes for evaluation by the Government; details of submittal and evaluation are listed at provisions 52.212-1 and 52.212-2, respectively. Additionally, please make note of the mandatory format for quoting pricing of laboratory analyses services and directly-associated laboratory supplies. Note: copies of NAVFAC Past Performance Questionnaire (PPQ) forms have been newly posted in the attachments as of December 29, 2025; in accordance with Federal regulations, the Government's preferred source of past performance are records at CPARS.gov (see FAR Subpart 42.15), but these PPQ forms may be used for state, municipal, and/or private sector projects that are appropriate as past performance. The Government may award an agreement to up to three (3) Contractors, at the Government's discretion and convenience. The Government will give fair consideration to all awardees in placing orders based on criteria stated in the solicitation. This will be a new procurement. It does not directly replace an existing contract. No prior contract information exists. UPDATED: The Government will only accept offers from Small Business concerns, but please be advised that there are also strict accreditation requirements (e.g. NELAP) to be considered as a responsible vendor. Interested, eligible Small Business concerns should, as early as possible but not later than 15 days of this notice, indicate interest in the acquisition by providing to the contracting office above evidence of capability to perform and a positive statement of eligibility as a small business concern. Competition between eligible vendors will be conducted to ensure best value selection, under Simplified Acquisition Procedures (ref: FAR Subpart 13.5 Simplified Procedures for Certain Commercial Products and Commercial Services). title: BUD-TBA Böckten - Hauptstrasse, Ingenieurleistungen einschliesslich Bauleitung SIA-Phasen 41-53
description:
Le marché porte sur les prestations d’ingénierie nécessaires à la remise en état de la Hauptstrasse à Böckten, sur un tronçon d’environ 820 mètres compris entre le pont sur l’Ergolz et la limite communale avec Gelterkinden. Le projet comprend notamment le remplacement complet de la superstructure routière, l’aménagement des trottoirs et des arrêts de bus, la rénovation du système d’évacuation des eaux de chaussée ainsi que divers travaux relatifs aux réseaux de conduites.

Le mandat comprend l’examen du projet de l’ouvrage existant ainsi que les prestations correspondant aux phases SIA 41 et 51 à 53. title: 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day
description: ? Celebrating Our 6th Annual Industry Day � Connecting Native-Owned Businesses with Albuquerque Area Indian Health Service (IHS) ? Monday, September 28 & Tuesday, September 29, 2026 ? 9:00 a.m. � 3:00 p.m. Mountain Daylight Time (MDT) ? Virtual Event | Microsoft Teams ?? FREE to Participate ? Space is limited. Registration will close once all vendor presentation slots have been filled. The Albuquerque Area Indian Health Service (IHS), Division of Contracts and Grants Management (DCGM), invites Native American-owned small businesses to participate in the 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day, a two-day virtual event dedicated to strengthening partnerships, expanding the Albuquerque Area IHS supplier base, and increasing awareness of the capabilities of Native American-owned businesses. Held shortly before Indigenous Peoples� Day, this event provides Native American-owned small businesses, including eligible Small Business Indian Firms (SBIFs) and Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs), an opportunity to introduce their organizations and showcase their capabilities directly to Albuquerque Area IHS acquisition professionals, program stakeholders, and organizational leadership. ?? Event Overview Day One will begin with introductions from Albuquerque Area IHS acquisition professionals and a brief overview of the Buy Indian Act and its role in supporting Indian economic enterprises through federal procurement. Following the opening session, participating vendors will receive an individually scheduled 10-minute presentation slot to introduce their businesses and highlight their capabilities, qualifications, products, services, past performance, and other information relevant to potential Albuquerque Area IHS requirements. Vendor capability presentations will continue throughout both days. ? Vendor Capability Presentations This is your opportunity to show Albuquerque Area IHS what your business can do! Each participating vendor will receive 10 minutes to present its capabilities directly to Albuquerque Area IHS personnel and other invited IHS acquisition and program professionals. Vendors are encouraged to use their presentation time to highlight information such as: Core capabilities and areas of expertise Products and/or services offered Relevant experience and past performance Geographic areas served Unique capabilities or solutions How your business can support IHS healthcare operations and mission requirements ? Who Will Be in the Audience? The Industry Day is designed to connect Native American-owned businesses with Albuquerque Area IHS personnel and other invited IHS acquisition and program professionals involved in identifying requirements, conducting market research, planning acquisitions, making purchases, and administering contracts. The audience may include: Buyers Contract Specialists Contracting Officers Contracting Officer�s Representatives (CORs) Government Purchase Cardholders and Approving Officials Service Unit Chief Executive Officers Program and technical personnel Albuquerque Area leadership This broad audience provides participating businesses an opportunity to increase awareness of their capabilities across IHS while helping acquisition and program personnel identify potential sources for future requirements. ? Why Participate? The Albuquerque Area IHS is committed to meaningful industry engagement and expanding opportunities for Native American-owned small businesses. Participation in Industry Day provides businesses an opportunity to: Introduce their company directly to IHS acquisition, program, and organizational personnel Increase awareness of their products, services, and capabilities Help IHS identify new and emerging industry capabilities Support IHS market research and acquisition planning Develop relationships with acquisition and program personnel Increase awareness of potential opportunities to do business with IHS At the same time, these interactions help Albuquerque Area IHS broaden its procurement base, identify qualified sources, increase competition, and strengthen relationships with the Native American-owned business community. We want to learn what your business can do for IHS. ? How to Participate Native American-owned small businesses interested in participating should email: ALBAreaSmallBusiness@ihs.gov Please indicate your interest in participating in the 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day and include your business name and primary point of contact. Upon receipt of your email, the Albuquerque Area IHS will provide a registration form to collect additional business information and assist with scheduling. Presentation times will be scheduled in advance. Each participating vendor will receive 10 minutes to present its capabilities, qualifications, products, and/or services. Space is limited, and registration will close once all available vendor presentation slots have been filled. Vendors are encouraged to register early. Additional event and Microsoft Teams information will be provided to registered participants prior to the event. ? Building Partnerships in Support of the IHS Mission Through the 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day, DCGM seeks to strengthen relationships with Native American-owned businesses, expand awareness of industry capabilities, broaden the Albuquerque Area procurement base, and identify qualified sources capable of supporting healthcare delivery. These partnerships help ensure that Albuquerque Area IHS acquisition professionals have access to capable and innovative businesses that can provide the supplies, services, equipment, and solutions necessary to support direct patient care and advance the IHS mission: �To raise the physical, mental, social and spiritual health of American Indians and Alaska Natives to the highest level.� ? Join us September 28-29, 2026, and show Albuquerque Area IHS what your business can do! ?? Important Notice This Industry Day is being conducted for informational, outreach, and market research purposes. This event is not a bidder�s conference, solicitation, Request for Proposal, Request for Quote, promise to contract, or commitment by the Government to award a contract. Participation in this event does not guarantee consideration for or award of any future procurement. The Government will not assume liability for costs incurred by any participant associated with attending the event or preparing, submitting, or presenting information, capability statements, presentations, or other materials. Costs incurred in response to this notice will not be considered allowable direct or indirect charges to the Government.

title: Netherlands – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Supply and Analysis of NH₃ Passive Samplers (Diffusion Tubes) for the MAN Network and additional projects
description: This European tender concerns a contract for the supply and laboratory analysis of ammonia (NH₃) passive samplers (diffusion tubes) for the Dutch ammonia monitoring network “Meetnet Ammoniak Nederland” (MAN) and various additional projects. The contractor will be responsible for the monthly supply of unexposed diffusion tubes to RIVM, the analysis of exposed tubes supplied by RIVM, and the digital reporting of validated results. Field deployment, return logistics of exposed tubes and internal data processing by RIVM fall outside the scope. The expected annual volume ranges from approximately 6,600 tubes in the baseline MAN scenario up to around 9,900 tubes including additional projects, with a maximum bandwidth of up to 30,000 tubes per year to accommodate future growth. If the contract is awarded to a new supplier, the first contract year will include a structured Double Measurement Programme, in which the new laboratory’s performance is systematically compared with the current trend laboratory to ensure continuity and trend stability in the MAN data series. The contract is tendered as one single, integrated lot combining tube supply, analysis and reporting with one contractor, using a best price‑quality ratio award criterion. The agreement has a fixed initial duration of six (6) years starting 1 January 2027, with five (5) optional one‑year extensions, for a maximum total duration of eleven (11) years.

title: Switzerland – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – UW Winkeln - GU Baumeisterarbeiten und Gebäudetechnik
description: 1 Présentation générale du projet Les équipements secondaires et les installations annexes de la sous-station de Winkeln ont atteint la fin de leur durée de vie technique et doivent être renouvelés. Les transformateurs combinés (à l’exception des baies CFF) seront remplacés par des transformateurs modernes en matériaux composites. Les installations de Swissgrid seront, dans la mesure du possible, dissociées de celles d’Axpo. À cette fin, Swissgrid construit un nouveau bâtiment dédié à la sous-station. Le projet comprend essentiellement : · Construction du bâtiment de la sous-station Swissgrid · Rénovation des postes de sectionnement existants · Construction d’un bâtiment séparé pour le matériel de mise à la terre · Construction d’une plate-forme au niveau supérieur/inférieur de l’installation pour la mise à la terre des barres omnibus · Remplacement des transformateurs combinés · Renouvellement de l’installation de mise à la terre et de la protection contre la foudre · Renouvellement et dissociation de l’appareillage secondaire · Renouvellement et dégroupage des télécommunications · Remplacement des installations annexes et installation dans le nouveau bâtiment de la sous-station · Alimentation pour les besoins propres par Axpo et les CFF · Renouvellement de la protection physique des sous-stations (PSU) avec clôture, portails et surveillance · Rénovation de l’éclairage du poste de coupure en plein air 220 kV 2 Projet de construction numérique Le projet « UW Winkeln 220 kV » est réalisé en tant que projet pilote pour la construction numérique. L’objectif est d’appliquer de manière systématique les méthodologies correspondantes à la construction et à la transformation de la sous-station afin d’améliorer considérablement la qualité de la planification, de l’exécution et de la documentation. Le mandataire des lots 10+15 agit sur le chantier en tant qu’entreprise chef de file. Les objectifs et les exigences pour les lots 10+15 comprennent l’utilisation obligatoire de la plateforme CDE centrale, l’exécution basée sur des modèles et la documentation « as-built », ainsi que la mise à disposition complète de l’infrastructure numérique du chantier, y compris un « centre de plans numérique » et une connexion Internet haut débit sur le chantier. Exigences en matière de construction numérique pour l’entrepreneur général (lots 10+15) · Direction des travaux et gestion des données : L’entrepreneur général agit en tant qu’entreprise chef de file. L’ensemble de la gestion du projet (documents, points en suspens, défauts) s’effectue obligatoirement via la plateforme Autodesk Forma mise à disposition par Swissgrid, qui fait office de « source unique de vérité ». · Infrastructure numérique du chantier : L’entrepreneur général est responsable de la mise à disposition et de l’exploitation d’un « centre de plans numérique » (BIM-Box) ainsi que d’une connexion Internet haut débit. buyer: Institutul National de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Inginerie Electrica ICPE-CA Bucuresti
title: Romania – Analysers – ANALIZOR VECTORIAL DE RETEA
description: Pentru indeplinirea obiectivelor propuse in planul de realizare din cadrul proiectului cu titlul ” Sistem tehnologic integrat inovativ pentru creșterea rezilienței controlului și comunicațiilor adaptat vectorilor de transport aerian sau maritim (Air Navy_Sys), finanțat de Autoritatea Națională pentru Cercetare, Direcția generală OI Cercetare, Serviciu Evaluare, Selecție și Contractare, Nr. 390076/16.10.2025, Cod SMIS 2021+ 331874, Cod apel: PCIDIF/159/PCIDIF_P1/OP1/RSO1.1/PCIDIF_A1 - Sprijin pentru proiecte de CDI pentru consorții tematice între parteneri publici-privați”, este necesara achizitia echipamentului „Analizor vectorial de rețea” destinat caracterizării RF a antenelor, rețelelor de antene, filtrelor RF, divizoarelor de putere, circuitelor pasive și structurilor RF de interconectare. Analizorul vectorial de rețea are drept scop dezvoltarea și implementarea unui sistem tehnologic integrat și inovativ care să îmbunătățească semnificativ reziliența și securitatea controlului și comunicațiilor pentru vectorii de transport aerian și maritim. Acest sistem trebuie să fie capabil să protejeze și să optimizeze funcționarea infrastructurii de transport prin abordarea provocărilor legate de interferențele electromagnetice intenționate (bruiaj si spoofing GNSS) și alte amenințări cibernetice, să îmbunătățească precizia și fiabilitatea sistemelor de radionavigație GNSS și să asigure o comunicare continuă și sigură. Prin implementarea proiectului se urmărește dezvoltarea de vehicule aeriene opțional pilotate și drone maritime de tip USV dotate cu sisteme de radionavigație GNSS reziliente. Aceste rezultate contribuie la creșterea capacităților de control și comunicare în medii critice, ceea ce are implicații semnificative pentru securitatea și eficiența operațiunilor de transport aerian și maritim. Reziliența GNSS este esențială pentru a asigura funcționarea continuă a acestor sisteme în condiții adverse, ceea ce face proiectul durabil din punct de vedere tehnologic.

Hankinnassa on kyse Vaasan kaupungin Isolahti Gerby päiväkodin vuokrapäiväkotihankkeesta. Hanke on vuokramallilla toteutettava päiväkoti, jonka paikkamäärä on 150 lapselle. Päiväkodissa on tilat 8 ryhmälle sekä lisäksi henkilökuntaa 40–45 henkilöä. Hankinta kattaa kohderakennuksen ylläpito- ja käyttäjäpalvelut sovittavan vuokrajakson ajan. Hankkeen toteuttajan vastuulla on rakennuksen käytettävyys ja olosuhteet n. 20-30 vuoden suunnitellulle vuokra-ajalle. Tavoitteena on allekirjoittaa vuokrasopimus vuoden 2027 alussa ja aloittaa rakennustyöt keväällä 2027. Kalustaminen käynnistyy heinäkuussa 2028. Kohteen käyttöönoton ajankohta on elokuun alussa 2028. Hankkeen toteuttaja vuokraa päiväkodin tontin kaupungilta. Vuokrakohde on vuokranantajan rakentama ja omistama lasten päiväkoti. Hankkeen hyötyala on alustavan tilaohjelman mukaisesti n. 2010,5 hym2. (Ei sisällä seinärakenteita.),

title: Lappeenrannan koulukuljetusten lisäkuljetukset
description: Lappeenrannan koulukuljetusten lisäkuljetukset Kyseessä on koulukuljetusten lisäkuljetusten hankinta. Hankinnan sopimuskausi on 1.1.2027-30.06.2029. TILAUSTAVAN KUVAUS: Oppilaille järjestetään ensisijaisesti kuljetus olemassa olevia joukkoliikenneyhteyksiä hyödyntäen oppilaiden lukujärjestys huomioon ottaen ja jos kyseisellä reitillä on tilaa. Jos sopivaa reittiä ei ole tai reittiä ajavassa oppilaskuljetuksessa ei ole tilaa, Lappeenrannan kaupunki järjestää oppilaalle kuljetuksen tätä puitesopimusta hyödyntäen. Sopimuskauden aikana kuljetustilaukset tehdään pyytämällä tarjoukset kustakin yksittäisestä kuljetuksesta jokaiselta puitesopimuksessa mukana olevalta Liikennöitsijältä. Tarjouspyynnön jättöaika riippuu siitä, kuinka nopeasti kuljetus tarvitaan. Tarjoukset pyydetään ensisijaisesti sähköpostitse kuvattuna muun muassa hankinnan kohde ja ajankohta. Mikäli sähköpostipyyntö ei tuota tulosta, Tilaaja pyytää tarjoukset toissijaisesti puhelimitse. Tilaaja valitsee sen Liikennöitsijän, jonka tarjous on edullisin. Tilaaja voi myös halutessaan tehdä tilauksen Liikennöitsijältä, joka vastaa parhaiten Tilaajan tarpeita. REITTIKOKONAISUUDEN KUVAUS: Kuljetukset tapahtuvat Lappeenrannan kaupungin alueella, ellei muuta mainita. Kiinteitä reittejä ei ole, vaan reitit määräytyvät kuljetustarpeen mukaisesti ja ne suunnitellaan tapauskohtaisesti. Täten kohteella ei myöskään ole säännöllisiä ajopäiviä, vaan mahdolliset ajopäivät määräytyvät tarpeen mukaan. Kohteen arvioitu vuosittainen ajopäivien enimmäislukumäärä on 188. Kohdekuvaus ja kalustovaatimukset ovat sopimuksen liitteessä 1. Liikennöitsijän tulee ilmoittaa, minkälaista kalustoa liikennöitsijällä on tarjota. - Henkilöauto, rekisteröity vähintään 1+4 - Esteetön ajoneuvo, mahdollisuus kuljettaa liikuntarajoitteisia, esimerkiksi pyörätuolivalmiudella, vähintään 1+8 - Tila-auto vähintään 1+8 - Joku muu -Linja-auto -Joku muu Kuljetukset ajoittuvat koulupäiville pääosin seuraavasti: - aamuisin ma-pe klo 07.00 – 10.00 ja - iltapäivisin ma-pe klo 12.00 – 16.00 (ma-pe klo 15.30 - 17.00 iltapäivätoiminnasta). Kuljetukset tapahtuvat Lappeenrannan kaupungin alueella, ellei muuta mainita. SOPIMUSMENETTELY: Kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät Liikennöitsijät valitaan mukaan sopimustoimittajiksi. Jokaisen puitesopimukseen valitun Liikennöitsijän kanssa tehdään saman sisältöinen sopimus. Tilauspyynnöt toimitetaan vain sopimustoimittajille. Tilaajalla ei ole määräostovelvoitetta. Muissa asiakirjoissa mahdollisesti esitetyt hankintamäärät ovat vain arvioita, eivätkä ne ole Tilaajaa sitovia. Sopimus ei tuota liikennöitsijälle yksinoikeutta tuottaa sopimuksen kohteena olevia palveluita. Mikäli Tilaaja ei saavuta tämän kilpailutuksen keinoin riittävän kattavaa palveluntarjoajien määrää alueellisesti tai lukumäärällisesti, varaa Tilaaja mahdollisuuden keskeyttää tämän hankintamenettelyn tekemättä hankintapäätöstä.,

title: Schutzbautenkataster Naturgefahren
description:
Die Abteilung Naturgefahren der Dienststelle Verkehr und Infrastruktur setzt sich für den Schutz vor Naturgefahren im Kanton Luzern ein. Sie fördert und realisiert Massnahmen, um die Risiken durch Hochwasser, Murgänge, Rutschungen, Steinschlag und Lawinen auf ein angemessenes Mass zu reduzieren. Wo erforderlich, werden hierfür geeignete Schutzbauwerke geplant und realisiert. 


Um den Bestand, den Zustand und die Wirksamkeit dieser Schutzbauwerke langfristig zu sichern, betreibt die Abteilung Naturgefahren einen Schutzbautenkataster als lokale Geodatenbank. Darin sind aktuell rund 40'000 Objekte gemäss kantonalem Datenmodell erfasst. 


Die bestehenden Daten sollen in eine moderne und sichere Fachanwendung überführt werden. Zu diesem Zweck beabsichtigt die Auftraggeberin, eine etablierte Standardsoftware inklusive Wartung und Support für fünf Jahre zu beschaffen. Der Lieferant übernimmt dabei nicht nur die Realisierung und Einführung der Applikation in der Organisation der Auftraggeberin, sondern unterstützt diese auch mit seiner bisherigen Erfahrung und bewährten Best Practices beratend. 


Hinweis:

Die Ausschreibungsunterlagen sind vertraulich. Den Anbietenden werden die Ausschreibungsunterlagen nach Einreichung der Geheimhaltungserklärung (verfügbar in den Unterlagen dieser Publikation) an livia.naef@lu.ch elektronisch zur Verfügung gestellt.

title: Tuchfilteranlage für die 4. Reinigungsstufe der Kläranlage Langen
description: Die Kläranlage Langen soll um eine 4. Reinigungsstufe zur Spurenstoffelimination erweitert werden. Auf Grundlage eines jahrelangen Forschungsprojekts auf der Kläranlage wurde eine Verfahrenskombination aus Tuchfiltration und Aktivkohlefiltration ausgewählt. In Vorbereitung auf sich ändernde Anforderungen an die Reinigungsleistung soll außerdem die Möglichkeit zu einer späteren Erweiterung um eine Ozonung vorgesehen werden. Die hydraulische Anbindung an den Bestand erfolgt über ein Zwischenhebewerk, welches den Ablauf der konventionellen Abwasserbehandlung in die neue Reinigungsstufe fördert und fortan als Hochwasserpumpwerk fungiert. Mit dieser Vergabe wird die Tuchfiltration ausgeschrieben. Weiterführende Informationen können dem vorliegenden Leistungsverzeichnis sowie den Vertragsunterlagen entnommen werden.

title: Concours portant sur les études et la réalisation pour une salle de gymnastique avec structure d'accueil de jour.
description:
Buchs ne se contente pas de commander un nouveau gymnase. Il s’agit plutôt de créer un équipement robuste, ancré dans l’école et le village pour les décennies à venir. Le bâtiment polyvalent de 1964 a rempli sa mission et peut désormais prendre sa retraite ; il laissera place à un gymnase double ainsi qu’à des locaux destinés aux structures d’accueil périscolaire et à l’enseignement musical. L’ensemble doit former, avec les bâtiments scolaires existants, une unité cohérente et convaincante, dotée d’espaces extérieurs qui ne soient pas de simples surfaces résiduelles et d’un « lieu de rencontre » qui devienne véritablement un point de ralliement.


Le projet exige donc bien plus que de beaux plans. Il requiert une précision urbanistique, une architecture de qualité, une organisation fonctionnelle, une grande flexibilité d’usage, une qualité écologique et une rationalité économique ; le tout conçu de manière à perturber le moins possible le fonctionnement de l’école durant les travaux. De plus, les évolutions futures ne devront pas nécessairement entraîner une transformation totale.


Le concours global suit la même logique : lors de la première phase anonyme, ce sont la posture, la stratégie et la cohérence du concept qui priment. S’ensuit une phase de dialogue avec les équipes sélectionnées pour approfondir, optimiser et chiffrer le projet, avant de formuler une offre ferme. L’objectif n’est pas de retenir la promesse la plus spectaculaire, mais la proposition globale la plus convaincante, alliant idée forte et faisabilité.


En résumé : réfléchir d’abord, affiner ensuite, chiffrer enfin, et construire de telle sorte que Buchs, non seulement à l’inauguration mais aussi vingt ans plus tard, puisse se dire : « C’était une bonne idée. »

Offerors or quoters are required to have an active Federal Government contracts registration in SAM when they submit an offer or quotation, and at the time of award (ref. RFO FAR 4.203-1(b)). title: ROKS TP4: Sanierung Triebwassersystem Ova Spin – Pradella; Stahlwasserbauarbeiten Triebwasserweg Ova Spin – Pradella; Los 23 – Stahlwasserbauarbeiten Triebwasserweg Ova Spin – Pradella
description:
Im Rahmen des Projekts «ROKS TP4 – Retrofit obere Kraftwerksstufe Ova Spin – Pradella» werden Revisionsarbeiten an der Drosselklappe sowie dem Ausbaurohr ausgeführt.

Die Arbeiten erfolgen im entleerten System unter Untertagebedingungen. Es handelt sich um Leistungen mit hohen Anforderungen an Arbeitssicherheit, Umweltschutz, Qualität und Dokumentation.

Betroffene Bauwerksabschnitte und Objekte mit geometrischen Hauptkennwerten:

  • Drosselklappe APK BAC (Ø 3.7 m, Gehäuselänge ca. 1.1 m, Auslegungsruck Gehäuse 154 mWS und Klappenteller 134 mWS), inklusive
  • Zwischenrohr APK BAC (Ø 3.7 m, Länge 3.25 m)
  • Ausbaurohr APK BAC (Ø 3.7 – 4.0 m, Länge ca. 5.0 m)


Die Ausführung ist über eine Bausaison im Jahr 2028 vorgesehen. Die Bausaison dauert rund 120 Kalendertage und ist zwischen Anfang Januar und Anfang Mai geplant. Aufgrund der alpinen Lage und der winterlichen Rahmenbedingungen sind witterungsbedingte Einschränkungen in Logistik, Materialtransport, Installationen und Bauablauf ausdrücklich zu berücksichtigen.

Die Arbeiten sind eng mit parallel ausgeführten Baumeister- sowie Stahlwasserbau und Korrosionsschutzarbeiten zu koordinieren. Schnittstellen bestehen insbesondere hinsichtlich Zugänglichkeit, Sicherheits- und Rettungsorganisation sowie Terminabstimmung.

Ausgeschriebener Leistungsumfang (insbesondere):

  • Baustelleninstallation für im Los 23 enthaltene Leistungen
  • Erstellung eines spezifischen Sicherheits- und Gesundheitsschutzkonzepts (SiGeKo)
  • Revision an Drosselklappe, Zwischenrohr und Ausbaurohr
  • Ersatz Geber und Sensoren inklusive Verkabelung und Einbindung in Steuerung
  • Ersatz Hydraulikaggregat
  • Ersatz Hydraulikverrohrung
  • Revision Hydraulikzylinder inklusive Prüfung (zfP)
  • Ersatz Spannungsversorgung und VerkabelungÜberarbeitung der Flanschflächen inklusive ober- und unterwasserseitigen Anschlusses
  • Qualitätssicherung und Prüfungen
  • Dokumentation (Prüf- und Messprotokolle, Materialchargen, Fotodokumentation, Abnahmeunterlagen)

title: ROKS TP4: Sanierung Triebwassersystem Ova Spin – Pradella; Stahlwasserbauarbeiten Triebwasserweg Ova Spin – Pradella: Los 22 – Stahlwasserbauarbeiten Triebwasserweg Ova Spin – Pradella
description:
Gegenstand und Umfang des Auftrags

Im Rahmen des Projekts «ROKS TP4 – Retrofit obere Kraftwerksstufe Ova Spin – Pradella» werden Revisionsarbeiten an Panzertüren, Drucktüren, Mannlöchern und Entwässerungs- sowie Entlüftungsleitungen im Triebwasserweg ausgeführt.

Die Arbeiten erfolgen im entleerten System unter Untertagebedingungen und sind abschnittsweise auszuführen. Es handelt sich um Leistungen mit hohen Anforderungen an Arbeitssicherheit, Umweltschutz, Qualität und Dokumentation.

Betroffene Bauwerksabschnitte und Objekte mit geometrischen Hauptkennwerten:

  • Vier (4) Panzertüren (Ø ca. 2.2 m), Revision
  • Zwei (2) Mannlöcher (1x Ø ca. 0.8 m, 1x Ø ca. 1.0 m), Revision
  •  Ersatz Schieber (je ein Betriebs- und ein Revisionsschieber mit Handantrieb) LAS (1x Ø 0.25 m, 1x Ø 0.20 m), SAM (2x Ø 0.30 m), SAT (3x Ø 0.30 m), BAC (1x Ø 0.30 m)
  • Neue Schieber (je ein Betriebs- und ein Revisionsschieber mit Handantrieb) SAM (1x Ø 0.15 m)
  • Neue Entwässerungsleitung SAM, rostfrei, 1x Ø 0.15 m, L ca. 14 m
  •  Verlängerung bestehende Entwässerungsleitung SAM, feuerverzinkt, Ø 0.30 m, L ca. 4 m
  • Wasserschloss Bain Crotsch; Drucktüre in oberer Wasserschlosskammer: ein (1) Stück Revision LW 2.8 x 2.2 m
  • Zuleitung Clemgia; Drucktüre in Fensterstollen: ein (1) Stück Revision LW 1.6 x 2.0 m

Die bestehende Korrosionsschutzbeschichtung ist PCB-haltig und komplett durch das Nebenlos 21 fachgerecht zu entfernen, bevor Trennarbeiten mit thermischer Einwirkung eingesetzt werden können (Brennschneiden, Trennscheibe).

Die Ausführung ist über drei Bausaisons in den Jahren 2028 - 2030 vorgesehen. Jede Bausaison dauert rund 90 Kalendertage und ist zwischen Anfang Januar und Anfang April geplant. Aufgrund der alpinen Lage und der winterlichen Rahmenbedingungen sind witterungsbedingte Einschränkungen in Logistik, Materialtransport, Installationen und Bauablauf ausdrücklich zu berücksichtigen.

Die Arbeiten sind eng mit parallel ausgeführten Baumeister- sowie Korrosionsschutzarbeiten zu koordinieren. Schnittstellen bestehen insbesondere hinsichtlich Zugänglichkeit, Sicherheits- und Rettungsorganisation sowie Terminabstimmung.

Ausgeschriebener Leistungsumfang (insbesondere):

  • Baustelleninstallation für im Los 22 enthaltene Leistungen
  • Revision an Panzer- und Drucktüren
  •  Ersatz von Entleerungs- und Entlüftungsschiebern inklusive Überarbeitung der anschliessenden Flanschflächen und Beschaffung neuer Schrauben
  • Neue Entwässerungsleitung, rostfrei
  • Verlängerung bestehende Entwässerungsleitung feuerverzinkt
  • zerstörungsfreie Prüfungen

title: Professional Services Supply Chain
description: The CRA has issued this Request for Proposal (RFP) to solicit bids from qualified professional services suppliers for contracts under the Professional Services Supply Chain (PSSC). The PSSC is the CRA’s suite of contracts for the provision of IT and certain non-IT professional services. Bidders must be able to supply consultants for every category and level after award. All responsive bids will be ranked, and contracts will be awarded to the five top-ranked bidders. Any requirements for consultants will then be competed amongst each of the contractors holding a contract. Bidders awarded a contract under the PSSC must provide consultants on an as-and-when requested basis, mainly for the CRA’s Information Technology Branch (ITB) within the National Capital Region (NCR); however, other branches and locations within the CRA may also make use of the PSSC. The work will be either remote or in-person. The period of the Contract is from April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2029 inclusive with options to extend the term of the contract by up to three additional one-year periods under the same conditions. The table below summarizes the total invoiced amounts under the Professional Services Supply Chain for the past three calendar years. January 1 – December 31 2023 - $61,283,633.32 January 1 – December 21 2024 - $41,421,783.98 January 1 – December 31 2025 - $15,606,254.92 As part of the Government of Canada’s (GC) continued commitment to responsible fiscal management, Budget 2023 announced significant reductions in discretionary spending on consulting, other professional services, and travel. The GC implemented $500 million in reductions in 2023-24, with ongoing annual reductions of $1.7 billion starting in 2024-25. Consequently, the CRA anticipates a continued decline in professional services procurement as it continues to realign resources to higher-priority areas. As the refocusing of GC spending is an ongoing process, however, the CRA is unable to quantify the extent of these reductions at this time. There are security requirements associated with this requirement. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers and to bidders of an applicable trading partner. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. The Policy on Prioritizing Canadian Suppliers and Canadian Content in Strategic Federal Procurements will be applied to contracts awarded pursuant to this solicitation. The Federal Contractors Program (FCP) for employment equity applies to this procurement. Proposal documents and supporting information must be submitted in either English or French. The CRA reserves the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Questions must be directed in writing to the contracting authority via email: Karan.Beaulieu@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids must be submitted by using the Connect service provided by the Canada Post Corporation. When responding, the proposal MUST be delivered to: Canada Revenue Agency Bid Receiving Unit BRUg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids will not be accepted if emailed directly to this email address. This email address must be used to request that CRA open a Connect conversation. Bidders must not use their own licensing agreement for Connect to initiate a Connect conversation with CRA.

title: Light Forces Enhancement
description: W8476-206234/C Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC) is requesting Industry feedback regarding the Light Forces Enhancement (LFE) project for the Government of Canada (GC), the Department of National Defence (DND), and the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF). The Canadian Light Forces (LF) need new light tactical personnel and cargo carrying capabilities. These capabilities will move soldiers and equipment across complex terrain which currently can only be reached on foot. It will lighten CAF soldiers’ on-person combat burden by carrying additional equipment and supplies, and will cover a larger area of operation through increased speed, range, and duration. This powerful, lightweight solution is expected to operate in domestic and expeditionary deployments, up to and including high threat environments. title: Bauherrenprojektleitung Erneuerung und Erweiterung Schulanlage Ibach, Schwyz
description:
Die Gemeinde Schwyz hat in den letzten Jahren ein starkes Wachstum erfahren. Im Hinblick auf die Entwicklung der Schülerzahlen und der künftigen Auslastung der einzelnen Schulräumen wurde 2023 ein Schulraumentwicklungskonzept erarbeitet. Im Rahmen dieser strategischen Auslegeordnung zeigte sich, dass die Klassenzimmer teilweise von der Grösse her knapp bemessen und nicht mehr zeitgemäss sind. Aus Kapazitätsgründen müssen einige Klassen für den Turnunterricht schon heute auf andere Schulanlagen ausweichen.


Insbesondere der Schulkreis Ibach leidet unter den knappen Platzverhältnissen, Die Schulinfrastruktur in Ibach umfasst drei Schulgebäude: das alte Schulhaus an der Gotthardstrasse sowie die Schulhäuser Christophorus und Muota, erbaut in den Jahren 1898, 1954 beziehungsweise 1968. Ergänzt wird der Schulkreis durch eine kleine Turnhalle aus dem Jahr 1954. Aufgrund der Platzproblematik wurde 2025 ein provisorischer Schulraumpavillon errichtet.

 

Der Gemeinderat beschloss 2025, eine Gesamtplanung mittels selektivem Projektwettbewerb für die Erneuerung und Ergänzung der Schulanlage Ibach durchzuführen. Die Schulanlage soll Raum für 10 Klassen des Zyklus 1, bestehend aus fünf Kindergartenklassen und fünf Klassen 1. und 2. Primarschulstufe sowie zehn Klassen des Zyklus 2, bestehend aus fünf Klassen (3. und 4.) sowie fünf Klassen (5. und 6. Primarschulstufe) und des Weiteren gemeinschaftlich genutzte Räume, die Tagesstruktur, eine Doppelsporthalle und die Aussenanlage bieten. Im Zuge der Anpassung und Erweiterung waren auch die Aussenräume der Schule und der Sportanlage mitzudenken und eine Parkierung sowie Schutzräume zu planen. Vor allem der Aussenraum sowie der Mehrzwecksaal sollen eine Doppelnutzung für die Öffentlichkeit/Vereine gewährleisten.

 

Aus den eingereichten Wettbewerbsbeiträgen wurde das Projekt «3MAL3» von Ernst Niklaus Fausch Partner, Zürich, zur Weiterbearbeitung empfohlen. Die Investitionssumme belaufen sich gemäss Kostenschätzung (+/- 30 %) auf Gesamtkosten von 45.0 Mio. Franken. Der Stimmbevölkerung wird an der Gemeindeversammlung vom 9. Dezember 2026 die Ausgabenbewilligung zum Projektierungskredit vorgelegt, die Abstimmung erfolgt am 28. Februar 2027.

 

Nach aktueller Terminplanung soll ab März 2027 die Ausarbeitung des Vor- und Bauprojekts starten, die Umsetzung erfolgt etappenweise. Mit dem Bau des neuen Schulhauses Muota soll im März 2029 begonnen werden, Bezugstermin 1. Juli 2031. Anschliessend erfolgt der Umbau und die Sanierung des alten Schulhauses Christophorus, der Bezug des neuen Schulhauses soll spätestens per 1. Juli 2034 stattfinden.

 

Vorbehältlich der Zusage der Stimmbevölkerung am 28. Februar 2027 wird mit der vorliegenden Ausschreibung die Bauherrenprojektleitung Erneuerung und Erweiterung Schulanlage Ibach gesucht. Sie führt das beauftragte Generalplanerteam und stellt die anforderungs- qualitäts-, termin- und kostengerechte Planung des Projekts über die SIA-Phasen 31 Vorprojekt bis 53 Inbetriebnahme sicher. Im Rahmen der Vorarbeiten sind möglichst alle Vorgaben an das Planerteam zu entwickeln und zu erarbeiten (Honorarvertrag mit Generalplanerteam, Projekthandbuch, Projektorganisation, Qualitätsmanagement, Submissionskonzept, Kostencontrolling, Ablagestruktur / Kollaborationstool usw.).

title: Remplacement du système d'appel résident
description:
Dans le cadre de cet appel d'offres, la mise en œuvre d'un système d'appel résident intégré pour le Feldheim fait l'objet du présent marché. Celui-ci comprend notamment les composants et fonctions suivants:


Terminaux et types d'appel pour les résidents

Le système doit permettre aux résidents de déclencher un appel au moyen d'un émetteur d'appel à bouton-poussoir. Cet émetteur d'appel peut se présenter par exemple sous la forme d'une montre-bracelet radio, d'un collier, d'une poire d'appel manuelle ou d'un bouton d'appel mural. Les boutons-poussoirs doivent être conçus, ou disponibles en variante, de manière à permettre aussi aux résidents présentant des limitations physiques ou motrices de déclencher l'appel de façon autonome. Selon le bordereau des prix, la quantité prévue pour les émetteurs d'appel destinés aux résidents est de 160 pièces.


Terminaux pour le personnel soignant

Pour le personnel soignant, des terminaux mobiles, ergonomiques et robustes sont prévus pour la réception, la prise en charge et l'acquittement des appels (85 pièces), avec une autonomie minimale de 10 heures par poste, sans recharge.


Capteurs

Il convient de mettre en œuvre des détecteurs de mouvement pour la détection des chutes et de l'activité (25 pièces), des tapis de sol sensibles à la pression (30 pièces), des nattes de détection de sortie de lit (6 pièces), ainsi que des détecteurs de porte pour la surveillance des issues dans le cadre de la protection contre la fugue (22 portes). Dans la mesure du possible, il convient de prévoir la réutilisation de capteurs existants compatibles ; à défaut, la fonction peut être assurée par une autre technologie ou solution intégrée au système proposé.


Pour le système d'appel résident, la maintenance et le support doivent être proposés pour une période de cinq ans.


Les autres détails relatifs à l'objet du marché sont décrits dans les documents « Teil B: Pflichtenheft » et « Anhang 3: Anforderungskatalog ».

title: Solicitation - BWT Operation and Maintenance
description: SOLICITATION - OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCE OF GOVERNMENT-OWNED FACILITIES AND EQUIPMENT, BLACK WARRIOR- TOMBIGBEE AND ALABAMA RIVER WATERWAYS PROJECT FACILITIES, ALABAMA - Furnish all planning, supervision, administration, labor, equipment, material, supplies, replacement or repair parts, and all things necessary for the Operations and Maintenance of Government-Owned Facilities and Equipment, Black Warrior- Tombigbee and Alabama River Waterways Project Facilities, Alabama. The project is geographically spread out over 13 counties in Alabama: Washington, Clarke, Marengo, Choctaw, Sumter, Hale, Greene, Tuscaloosa, Monroe, Wilcox, Dallas, Lowndes, and Autauga Counties, on the Black Warrior and Tombigbee BWT River System and the Alabama River System. The Project Management Office has responsibility for the operation and maintenance of nine locks and dams, two resource offices, a Project Management Office, two boat houses, one boat storage facility, storage buildings, two contractor maintenance compounds, and two hydro-electric generating plants. The BWT/AL Project is home to 9 beautiful lakes, they include Bankhead, Holt, Oliver, Warrior, Demopolis, Coffeeville, Claiborne, Millers, and RF Henry. These lakes for the BWT stretch from the headwaters near Birmingham, AL, south through Tuscaloosa and Demopolis to the southernmost Mobile District Corps facility located below Coffeeville, and for the AL river south from Montgomery, AL to the confluence with the Tombigbee River. The project is operated under the direction of Mobile District, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Mobile, Alabama. It is anticipated that one 1 Firm-Fixed Price FFP, Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity IDIQ, Single Award Task Order Contract SATOC will be awarded for a five 5-year ordering period. In general, not all inclusive, services to be performed include general maintenance, cleaning, custodial service, garbage removal, grass mowing, saddle dike and overlook clearing, debris removal, clerical duties at a Resource Office, repair to riprap slopes, repair to earthen slopes, excavation, and storage and disposal of hazardous and-or toxic materials, such as herbicides and waste fluids from vehicle maintenance. The IDIQ performance work statement PWS will include, but is not limited to, the following types of work: maintenance and repair of locks, dams, levees, riprap-concrete structures, flow structures, buildings, offices, maintenance facilities, operation areas, project roads, vehicles, floating plant, boathouses, bathhouses, washhouses, toilets, gatehouses, security and other fences, sanitary disposal systems, small boat launching ramps, playground equipment, bulletin boards, game courts, water and electrical systems, telephone lines, picnic sites, campsites, and other related facilities. Tasks required to perform this type of maintenance include carpentry, masonry, electrical, electronics, mechanical, structural, plumbing, chipping, caulking, sealing, cleaning, welding and replacing parts of or full pieces of equipment. Additional maintenance work includes guardrails, gates, electric barrier gates, signs, bumper blocks, landscaped areas, beaches, navigation or swimming buoys, paved roads, parking lots, trails, navigation aids, courtesy docks, and boundary lines. Operational requirements encompass the maintenance of a specialized floating plant comprising a primary towboat, crane barge, and auxiliary workboats and barges to support the Black Warrior-Tombigbee BWT and Alabama River Systems. This area of responsibility AOR extends from the mouth of the Mobile River to Birmingham on the BWT system and to Montgomery on the Alabama River system. These multi-purpose civil works projects are vital to facilitating commercial navigation, supporting public recreation, and managing regional wildlife habitats. This procurement is 100% set-aside for small business.
